risk_if_not_implemented: Without Security of Assets & Media, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Physical Crime (MT-5), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Physical & Environmental Protections
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the operation of physical and environmental protection controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Physical & Environmental Protections (PES-02) provides physical access control that compensates for the absence of Security of Assets & Media (AST-18) by preventing unauthorized physical interaction with systems and infrastructure. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Media Storage
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to: 
(1) Physically control and securely store digital and non-digital media within controlled areas using organization-defined security measures; and
(2) Protect system media until the media are destroyed or sanitized using approved equipment, techniques and procedures.
compensating_control_2.justification: Media Storage (DCH-13) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Security of Assets & Media (AST-18) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Data applicability. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
